title: Court-floor holding cells.
officialText:
Where separate court-floor holding cells are provided for males, juvenile males, adult
females or juvenile females, each courtroom shall be served by one accessible cell of each type. Where court-floor holding cells
are provided and are not separated by age or sex, courtrooms shall be served by at least one accessible cell. Accessible cells shall
be permitted to serve more than one courtroom.
